name: rgb-node
description: ESP32-C3 Super Mini 3-Channel RGB LED Driver with Web UI & Audio DSP

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:firmware
scripts.upload:fs: npm run build:web && pio run -t uploadfs
scripts.ota:fs: npm run build:web && pio run -e esp32c3-supermini-ota -t uploadfs
scripts.ota:all: npm run ota && npm run ota:fs

author: Ian McMurray
